pre_condition: spec is a dict whose 'pre_condition' and 'post_condition' keys, when present, map to strings.
post_condition: Returns a pair (pre, post) where pre is the string value associated with the 'pre_condition' key in spec (or an empty string when the key is absent) and post is the string value associated with the 'post_condition' key in spec (or an empty string when the key is absent).
